body.title: Add the comment rules
body.summary: Add src/workflow/tracker/comment-rules.ts: classifyComment (first line /revise or revision: gives revision-request, /suggest or suggestion: gives suggestion, else comment), isFrameworkComment (any insrc marker comment, no legacy shape), the actor of a tracker login (github:<lowercased login>, github:unknown for an empty or deleted author) and the feedback entry id tracker:<comment id>.
acceptanceChecks: Only the first line decides the kind, any case, and ordinary prose that starts with the word suggestion is a comment
isFrameworkComment is true for the insrc:post, insrc:review, insrc:handoff, insrc:attach and insrc:feedback markers and false for human text and for the old unmarked Attached comment
A mixed-case login gives its lowercased github actor, and an empty author gives github:unknown
The entry id is tracker: followed by the comment id

tests.name: comment-rules.test.ts: classifyComment gives revision-request, suggestion or comment from the first line only
comment-rules.test.ts: isFrameworkComment recognises every insrc marker and no human text
comment-rules.test.ts: the author and the entry id are derived from a tracker comment, a mixed-case login lowercased
